title: Radial Nodal Dirichlet Solutions of Singular Elliptic Equations: Global Branches, Endpoint Asymptotics, and Morse Indices
summary: We establish sharp finite-ball shooting classifications for radial nodal Dirichlet solutions of the logarithmic equation and, within the maximal simple-zero shooting class, of the sublinear scalar-field equation. Recent whole-space uniqueness and phase-transition theorems are used as external inputs, while the finite-ball zero-curve ranges, endpoint asymptotics, and spectral consequences are proved here.
